title: Premium Valle de Guadalupe Wine and Food Tour
blurb:
Discover Valle de Guadalupe like a local with Baja Society Tours! Your day starts cruising Baja’s coast with a stop in Rosarito for fresh Baja-style tacos at a family-run spot. 

Then visit 3 boutique wineries, sampling reds, whites, and rosé while learning about the winemaking process. Lunch is served at the second winery with delicious options filled with local ingredients and vibrant flavors — vegetarian options available. 

Relax in a private van stocked with cold beer and bottled water as you soak in stunning views and capture insta-worthy moments. 

Public tours typically run Saturdays, starting ~8:30 AM and returning ~7 PM. A minimum of 6 guests required. All-inclusive—no extra costs day of (tips appreciated). US pickup/drop-off available for an additional fee. 

Need more info? Reach out to Baja Society Tours - SoCal's #1 rated Baja food, wine, and private transportation company!
